pass_rule: Table parses (fail closed). Every item D1 to Q1 has a row of its type whose Point and Quote match every pattern, whose Page is in pages, and whose Quote is on that page. Every row's Quote is on its cited page (one miss fails the round). No row without a page. One attendee row per attendee A1 to A4. Counter-metrics: words of the brief per pack page (15 pages), and rows with no page.

fact_check.salt_rule: Before the fact-check round, two rows are added to the brief under test: S1 is the C2 quote cited at its printed page (10 instead of 12); S2 is an invented quote on page 14. Pass: every row's verdict matches the checker (kept when the quote holds on the cited page; struck, or corrected to a page where the quote holds, when it does not), and both salted rows are caught.
